heading: Authorization of appropriations
lead: There is hereby authorized to be appropriated not more than $23,000,000 for the acquisition of lands and interests in land pursuant to sections 459e to 459e–9 of this title, and, after December 23, 1980, not more than $500,000 for development.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 1980—Pub. L. 96–585 inserted provision authorizing $500,000 appropriation for development. 1978—Pub. L. 95–625 substituted “$23,000,000” for “$18,000,000”. 1976—Pub. L. 94–578 substituted “$18,000,000” for “$16,000,000”.
